featured_reviews.name: Saurabh Prajapati
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had my first ACL surgery in 2019, done by another doctor. Unfortunately, that operation was not very successful, and a few years later, after a minor incident, I tore my ACL again. This time, I consulted multiple doctors, one of whom was Dr. Mihir Patel—highly recommended to me by my brother, who had undergone the same surgery with him and had an excellent outcome.

From my very first consultation, Dr. Mihir gave me complete clarity about my case. He explained in detail that my situation required a two-step procedure:
1.	First surgery – to clean up all the debris from my previous failed operation and fill the tunnel with a bone graft, allowing it to heal and strengthen over 3 months.
2.	Second surgery – the ACL reconstruction once the bone graft had properly healed.

While some other doctors suggested doing it in a single step, I had already researched thoroughly and knew that in my specific case, the correct and standard approach was exactly what Dr. Mihir recommended. His detailed explanation gave me full confidence that I was in the right hands.

Accepting the two-step process wasn’t easy, because staying home and limiting activity is tough. But Dr. Mihir guided me at every stage. After the first surgery, he did not unnecessarily send me for physiotherapy—instead, he told me the exact set of exercises I should do at home and asked me to follow them diligently. I followed everything exactly as he instructed. After 60 days, he told me to return to the gym and focus on strengthening my legs so that the second surgery and recovery would be smoother.

This structured guidance worked wonders. For the first two months after my second surgery, he again gave me clear exercises to do at home instead of immediately going for physiotherapy. Only once he saw good progress, he told me to start gym training again and gradually increase the strengthening process. Today, just 3 months after my second surgery, I am already back in the gym, working out and regaining strength.

I’ve seen many ACL patients struggle because they don’t follow strengthening properly, but Dr. Mihir made it clear to me from the very beginning: leg strengthening is the most important part of ACL recovery. Following his advice has made my recovery much faster and smoother.

What truly sets Dr. Mihir apart is not just his surgical expertise but also his dedication and personal attention. He never rushed through appointments, never dismissed my doubts, and always made me feel comfortable asking questions. He patiently explained every detail, calmly answered my repeated concerns, and kept reassuring me that everything would be fine as long as I followed his guidance. His positivity and confidence made a huge difference in my recovery journey.

I am truly grateful to Dr. Mihir Patel—not only for a successful surgery but also for giving me the right direction, discipline, and mindset to recover strongly. His professionalism, knowledge, and genuine care for his patients are remarkable.

If anyone is struggling with an ACL injury or is unsure about the right treatment approach, I would wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Mihir Patel. He is one of the best doctors you can trust for ACL surgeries and recovery.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a sports-related knee injury back in 2019, which I ignored for years due to work and professional commitments. Over time, especially in the last 2–3 years, it started affecting me significantly. Then in August 2024, while playing sports again, I re-injured the same knee. The very next day, I visited Dr. Mihir Patel with my MRI scan.

Dr. Patel carefully examined the scan and explained everything in a very clear and systematic way. He didn’t just lay out the problem—he explained what exactly was wrong, what my options were, and what each solution would mean for me. What truly stood out was how he considered my age, lifestyle, and profession while advising me. It didn’t feel transactional at all—his approach was thoughtful and personal. He gave me time to think, decide, and plan accordingly.

After a few weeks of preparation, I underwent ACL, MCL, and meniscus surgery with Dr. Patel. The surgery was a success. I was discharged the very next evening, and he provided me with a detailed recovery plan, including home physiotherapy support. His team arranged for a physio to visit regularly, which made the recovery process smoother.

Now, a few months later, I’ve been going to the gym again for about a month, and the difference is incredible. I have access to a whole new realm of movement that I’d been restricted from for years. I can walk with full confidence, bear weight equally on both legs, and my posture has improved noticeably. After long days of work—standing, walking, and moving constantly—I can now return home, lie down in bed, and not feel that excruciating pain I used to every single night. That relief is something I didn’t think would ever become a reality… but it has, and it’s all thanks to Dr. Patel.

I honestly cannot thank Dr. Mihir Patel enough for helping me through this journey. If you are looking for a top-notch orthopedic surgeon in Mumbai who truly knows what he’s doing and cares about his patients beyond just the surgery, I wholeheartedly recommend him.

I took an appointment every time I visited, yet the doctor always seemed to be in a hurry and carried a very negative approach. There are two kinds of professionals: one who tells the truth while still motivating the patient to believe in recovery, and another who only talks in terms of giving up. Unfortunately, I experienced the latter.

As an athlete, hearing statements like “you will never be able to work out again” and “you will damage your body completely” was extremely demotivating. What made it worse was that my MRI showed two findings, but the doctor only noticed one—the second issue had to be pointed out by me during the next visit. This reflected a lack of attentiveness.

By God’s grace and with guidance from other competent and positive doctors, I am now healthy, fit, and doing everything I used to do. According to this doctor’s outlook, that would have been impossible—which clearly wasn’t the case. I also consulted a very renowned specialist who explained that everything was manageable and could be resolved.

A small piece of advice: a doctor should always speak the truth, but with hope and responsibility. Patients come seeking guidance, not hopelessness. To anyone reading this if you feel demotivated, do not lose heart. Take a second or even third opinion. The right doctor can make a world of difference.

After the surgery, he was very attentive, making sure my family knew what was going on and when they could see me.

Dr. Merchant continues to follow up with me to make sure I'm recovering well and following his instructions for a quick recovery. Thanks to his care, I'm already moving my fingers and showing signs of improvement just a few days after the surgery.

Additionally, I found Dr. Merchant's treatment fees to be very pocket-friendly, which was a huge relief given the unexpected nature of the accident.

Overall, my experience with Dr. Milind Merchant has been wonderful. He treats his patients with great care and attention, making sure everything is as stress-free as possible. His thorough and patient approach has truly helped me focus on getting better rather than worrying about the logistics of treatment.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Dr. Shreyash Gajjar is an impeccable and an outstanding doctor and an orthopaedic surgeon. I met him in November, 2024 after having an MRI scan of my shoulder regarded my injury during September, 2024.

Being an athlete, falling down while playing or having minute cuts while my sessions or competitions was an everyday occurrence for me. I am prominently and thrower and my events are shotput and discus throw but during my 10th, I was elected to play and represent my school in a volleyball match during the DSO district games of 2024. During our semi-finals, I had dived to pick up the ball ad score a point against the opponent team in which I dislocated my right shoulder (right being my leading hand) but had no idea about the injury and nor the pain due to the adrenaline rush at the moment. Later on, I was having my regular gym sessions and my practice sessions with some restrictions in my shoulder but there was no pain noticed.

In November, the pain started to aggravate which is when we decided to have a CT-SCAN and an MRI of my shoulder in which we discovered that I had a Bankart Tear + Hill-Sachs lesion in my right shoulder. That was the time when we consulted Dr. Gajjar and paid him a visit in KokilaBen Hospital. We visited him on 21st of November, 2024 which is when he told us that I would be needed to go under a surgery in order to repair my tissues. My parents were petrified hearing the news of the surgery with the only concern that would I be able to play sports ever again, but whenever my parents asked Dr. Gajjar whether I would be able to play again or not, his only response use to be ‘Why wouldn’t he be to play’ with a smile on his face.

I was operated on 23rd of November, 2024 going under an arthroscopy done by Dr. Gajjar. For various weeks after the surgery, my hand was to be kept in the arm sling pouch as there was no moment to be done with my right hand due to the surgery. Being an athlete and an ADHD diagnosed child, it was very difficult for me to have no movement by my prominent hand which was very disturbing. Whenever I use to complain about this to Dr. Gajjar, he used to say ‘If you want a career in your sports ahead, do what I say’.

And now, after over a year of my surgery, I say that consulting Dr. Gajjar was on the best decisions to be made by my parents in my life because now, I lift weights with more confidence and more precisely without any pain and any hindrance in my movements regarding my right shoulder. There can’t be a better orthopaedic surgeon than him for me in this world because his diagnosis, his expertise, him as a mentor also and as a support to me during my recovery and my rehab would not have been the same if it was not him. THANK YOU VERY MUCH SIR for helping me out through the bad time and only because of you, I am again able to continue with my sports journey ahead.
